proof_body:
by
  intro a p x ha
  constructor
  · rw [mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left ha, sq_pos_iff, sub_ne_zero]
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 : (x - p) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra hn
        push_neg at hn
        have := mul_pos ha hn
        linarith
      have h2 : (x - p) ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm h1 (sq_nonneg _)
      have h3 : x - p = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (two_ne_zero) |>.1 h2
      linarith
    · rintro rfl
      simp
